title: user.updated
description: Emitted by the User Service whenever a profile, preferences, or address change is durably persisted. Consumed by Notification Service (channel-preference re-evaluation) and Recommendation Engine (per-user feature refresh). The full user envelope (id, external_auth_id, email, status) is denormalized so consumers do not need to call back to the User Service. Topic: user.updated. Partition key: user_id. Subject in Schema Registry: user.updated-value. Satisfies AAP R-30 (topic name mirrors event name), R-31 (version field for backward-compatible evolution), R-32 (producer does not enumerate consumers), R-33 (event is self-contained).

event_id.description: Globally unique identifier for this event instance. Used by consumers as the idempotency key when processing the message.

version.description: Event payload schema version per AAP R-31. Incremented when the schema evolves backward-compatibly.

user_id.description: User aggregate identifier. Equals the `id` column of `users.users` and the partition key for all `user.*` Kafka events; guarantees per-user strict ordering across topics.

external_auth_id.description: Stable identifier from the Auth Service `sub` (subject) claim. Carried so downstream services can correlate with auth-side state without calling back to the User Service.

email.description: User's primary email address AFTER the update (post-change value). Lowercase, RFC-5321/5322 validated. Carried as part of the denormalized user envelope per AAP R-33.

status.description: User lifecycle status AFTER the update. Mirrors the `users.status` column. `active`: normal account; `suspended`: temporarily disabled (login blocked, profile preserved); `deleted`: soft-deleted (anonymized; emits a separate `user.deleted` event).

user_version.description: Optional. Optimistic-concurrency token (the `version` column of the user aggregate) AFTER the update was applied. Allows consumers to detect stale events when out-of-order delivery occurs.

changes.description: Structural description of what changed in this update.

changed_fields.description: Dot-notation paths of fields that changed (e.g., `profile.first_name`, `preferences.email_opt_in`, `addresses.<address_uuid>.line1`, `addresses.added`, `addresses.removed`). Sourced from the User aggregate's ProfileChange / PreferencesChange / AddressChange tuples.

category.description: Optional. High-level category enabling consumer-side filtering without parsing dot paths. The producer emits one event per category when multiple categories change in a single transaction.

updated_at.description: RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 timestamp (UTC, with offset suffix) at which the update transaction was committed. Mirrors the `users.updated_at` column AFTER the update.
